mapper.sql: bill_id AS "id",proj_id AS "projectId",bill_ord::int AS "order",bill_ym AS "month",bill_dt AS "billingDate", sply_amt AS "supply",vat_rt AS "rate",vat_amt AS "vat",tot_amt AS "total",rcpt_sum_amt AS "receiptCache", unpaid_amt AS "unpaidCache",pay_due_dt AS "dueDate",tax_invc_no AS "invoice",cncl_yn AS "cancelled", cncl_rsn AS "cancelReason",cncl_user_id AS "cancelUserId",cncl_dttm AS "cancelledAt", reg_user_id AS "registeredBy",reg_dttm AS "registeredAt",mod_user_id AS "modifiedBy",mod_dttm AS "modifiedAt"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_bl_bill ORDER BY bill_id

SELECT rcpt_id::bigint AS "id",bill_id AS "billId",rcpt_dt AS "date",rcpt_amt AS "amount",cncl_yn AS "cancelled", cncl_rsn AS "reason",cncl_user_id AS "cancelUserId",cncl_dttm AS "cancelledAt",reg_user_id AS "registeredBy", reg_dttm AS "registeredAt",mod_user_id AS "modifiedBy",mod_dttm AS "modifiedAt" FROM tb_bl_rcpt WHERE bill_id=#{id} ORDER BY rcpt_id
SELECT asgn_id FROM tb_pj_asgn WHERE proj_id=#{projectId} ORDER BY asgn_id
SELECT dev_id AS "id",dev_nm AS "name",mng_no AS "managementNo" FROM tb_hr_dev WHERE dev_id=#{id}
SELECT bill_id FROM tb_bl_bill WHERE proj_id=#{projectId} AND cncl_yn='N' ORDER BY bill_ym DESC,bill_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT count(*)::int FROM tb_bl_bill WHERE proj_id=#{projectId} AND bill_ym=#{month} AND cncl_yn='N'
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_pj_asgn_mon WHERE proj_id=#{projectId} AND input_ym=#{month} AND fix_yn='Y')
SELECT COALESCE(max(right(bill_id,3)::int),0) FROM tb_bl_bill WHERE bill_ym=#{month}
SELECT COALESCE(max(bill_ord)::int,0) FROM tb_bl_bill WHERE proj_id=#{projectId}
mapper.update: LOCK TABLE tb_cl_close IN SHARE MODE
UPDATE tb_bl_bill SET cncl_yn='Y',cncl_rsn=#{reason},cncl_user_id=#{actor},cncl_dttm=#{now}, rcpt_sum_amt=0,unpaid_amt=0,mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=#{now} WHERE bill_id=#{id} AND cncl_yn='N'
